content_html:
Autumn is a sensible time to check the small bits of equipment that can make driving easier as the days become darker, colder and wetter. The most useful purchases are usually the ones that solve a real problem rather than simply adding clutter to the boot.

1. Portable jump starter

A compact jump starter can be useful if your 12V battery lets you down, but compatibility matters. Check the manufacturer's engine-size guidance, battery type, peak-current specification and safety protections before buying. Keep the unit charged and follow both the vehicle and jump-starter instructions carefully.

Compare portable jump starters on Amazon UK

2. Digital tyre inflator

A portable inflator is handy for routine pressure checks and dealing with a slowly deflating tyre. Look for an automatic shut-off, a clear pressure display, a suitable maximum pressure and a cable or battery arrangement that will comfortably reach all four wheels.

Compare digital tyre inflators on eBay UK

Compare digital tyre inflators on Amazon UK

3. Rechargeable torch

A rechargeable torch is useful for checking a tyre, finding something in the boot or making yourself easier to see while stopped somewhere safe. Prioritise decent battery life, a robust casing and simple controls. A magnetic base can also be useful when working around a vehicle.

Compare rechargeable torches on eBay UK

Compare rechargeable torches on Amazon UK

4. Secure phone mount

A good phone mount keeps navigation visible without encouraging you to handle the phone while driving. Check where the mount will sit, whether it blocks your view, how securely it grips your phone and whether it fits your dashboard, windscreen or air vent without interfering with controls.

Compare car phone mounts on eBay UK

Compare car phone mounts on Amazon UK

5. Dash cam and the right memory card

A dash cam can be useful for recording journeys and incidents, but the supporting accessories matter too. Check recording resolution, field of view, parking-mode requirements, power method and whether the memory card meets the camera manufacturer's speed and endurance recommendations.

Compare dash cams on eBay UK

Compare dash cams on Amazon UK

What should you buy first?

If reliability is your main concern, a tyre inflator and a properly specified jump starter are sensible places to begin. If you regularly use navigation, a secure phone mount may make a bigger day-to-day difference. For frequent driving, a dash cam can be worth considering once you have checked installation and memory-card requirements.

Whichever product you choose, compare the exact specification, compatibility, warranty, seller or retailer reputation, delivery costs and returns policy before buying.

Prices, offers and availability change regularly. Always check the live listing and current product specifications before purchasing.
